tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: (6) The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by a UCB to the customers upfront in the loan agreement and KFS as applicable, in addition to being displayed on the UCB’s website under Interest rates and Service Charges.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.special_circumstance: providing only a reference to the schedule of penal charges displayed on the website
tuples.quote: Further, providing a reference to the schedule of penal charges displayed on the website of a UCB in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice.
